valid_auction.name: valid_auction
valid_auction.value: "auctions"."minimum" > 0 AND "auctions"."increment" > 0 AND "auctions"."ends" > "auctions"."starts" AND "auctions"."current" >= 0 AND "auctions"."upgrade" BETWEEN 0 AND 9 AND "auctions"."quantity" > 0 AND "auctions"."status" IN ('active','closed','cancelled')
